title: Lover Is a Day
lyrics:
[00:42.59]Time changed, we're different
[00:45.93]But my mind still says redundant things, can I not think?
[00:51.86]Will you love this part of me?
[00:54.96]My lover is a day I can't forget
[01:03.90]Furthering my distance from you
[01:07.60]Realistically, I can't leave now
[01:11.36]But I'm okay as long as you keep me from going crazy
[01:19.92]Keep me from going crazy
[01:25.23]Straight up ahead, you'll find a sign
[01:29.95]That says you can't get by with a lie
[01:35.66]But if I stayed away by a thread from the glory path
[01:40.94]And made my life harder, lying 'bout the stupid shit I say
[01:46.67]Then you wouldn't know a single thing
[01:50.33]About how I feel about you and all those really dumb things people feel
[01:57.00]I'll take the bumpy road, it'll probably break my legs
[02:02.33]As long as I don't show you what's ruining my head
[02:07.87]Funny thing about you is you read me pretty well
[02:12.61]But you haven't found me yet at the bottom of the well
[02:18.27]Annoying you with smoke signals, asking you for help
[02:23.63]'Cause your immediate presence lifts me straight away from hell
[02:29.19]Me and Mr. Heart, we say the cutest things about you
[02:34.58]How you seem unreal and we'd probably die so quick without you
[02:39.78]Suffocated from the radiated air around us
[02:44.59]Full of happiness we don't have, brightness gone, so dark without you, girl
[02:50.58]Time changed, we're different
[02:53.86]But my mind still says redundant things, can I not think?
[02:59.82]Will you love this part of me?
[03:03.00]My lover is a day I can't forget
[03:11.90]Furthering my distance from you
[03:15.55]Realistically, I can't leave now
[03:19.34]But I'm okay as long as you keep me from going crazy
[03:27.93]Keep me from going crazy
[03:33.25]Family calls me crazy and my friends say I'm degenerate
[03:38.01]But you tell me I'm so generous and my self-worth isn't hideous
[03:43.65]This psychedelic canvas of the person I'm becoming
[03:48.59]Went from horror movie on TV to happy-ending-princess me
[03:54.54]Processing the information transferred from your mind to me
[03:59.61]At light speed like the Falcon from the original Star Wars trilogy
[04:05.17]Feeling like a free ol' me when I was six and no worries
[04:10.30]Would stop me from reaching the stars a million miles away from me
[04:15.88]Sick in the head for you and no cure has been discovered
[04:20.58]Like a plague hitting my body except if I fall, I'm just fallin' for you
[04:26.56]Conscious beyond knowledge, alterations are acknowledged
[04:31.34]And the beauty you've inflicted is always in its action
[04:37.21]Lovely day today, perfect time to open up to you
[04:42.35]But I know that you're having fun, wouldn't wanna mess this up for you
[04:47.94]But I'm happy that you're happy, at least I do that much for you
[04:53.20]Always glad you're with me, this emotion will be gone before you know
[04:58.60]Time changed, we're different
[05:01.91]But my mind still says redundant things, can I not think?
[05:07.86]Will you love this part of me?
[05:10.90]My lover is a day I can't forget
[05:19.90]Furthering my distance from you
[05:23.57]Realistically, I can't leave now
[05:27.27]But I'm okay as long as you keep me from going crazy
[05:35.94]Keep me from going crazy, girl

[05:44.61]But my mind still says redundant things, can I not think?
[05:50.57]Will you love this part of me?
